# Cooki UI — Full Developer & AI Agent Specification

Generated: 2026-10-04T10:32:56.729Z
Components in Registry: 44

## Architecture Overview
Cooki UI is designed as a source-first, registry-driven component platform. Each component lives in `registry/[category]/[slug]/` with its exact implementation, isolated demo, and shadcn-compatible `metadata.json`.

---

## Component Registry Directory

### Generative Animated Mesh Gradient (`animated-mesh-background`)
- **Category**: backgrounds
- **Description**: Deep spatial canvas mesh gradient with animated organic noise displacement.
- **Tags**: N/A
- **Dependencies**: None
- **Registry Endpoint**: `https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/animated-mesh-background.json`
- **CLI Command**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/animated-mesh-background.json`

#### Installation & Usage
```tsx

export default function Example() {
  return <AnimatedMeshBackground />
}
```

### Kinetic Split Character Spring (`split-text`)
- **Category**: text
- **Description**: Character-level split typography animation with spring physics.
- **Tags**: N/A
- **Dependencies**: framer-motion
- **Registry Endpoint**: `https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/split-text.json`
- **CLI Command**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/split-text.json`

#### Installation & Usage
```tsx
import { SplitText } from "@/components/ui/split-text"

export default function Example() {
  return <SplitText />
}
```

---

### Masked Text Reveal (`text-reveal`)
- **Category**: text
- **Description**: Cinematic word-by-word mask displacement reveal with customizable stagger delays.
- **Tags**: N/A
- **Dependencies**: framer-motion
- **Registry Endpoint**: `https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/text-reveal.json`
- **CLI Command**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/text-reveal.json`

#### Installation & Usage
```tsx
import { TextReveal } from "@/components/ui/text-reveal"

export default function Example() {
  return <TextReveal />
}
```

### Dynamic Typewriter Loop (`typing-text`)
- **Category**: text
- **Description**: Autonomous multi-phrase typewriter with natural typing rhythm and blinking cursor.
- **Tags**: N/A
- **Dependencies**: None
- **Registry Endpoint**: `https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/typing-text.json`
- **CLI Command**: `npx shadcn@latest add https://cooki-ui.vercel.app/r/typing-text.json`

#### Installation & Usage
```tsx
import { TypingText } from "@/components/ui/typing-text"

export default function Example() {
  return <TypingText />
}
```
